For if you confess with your mouth the Lord Jesus,
et in corde tuo credideris quod Deus illum suscitavit a mortuis,

Omnis qui credit in illum, non confundetur.
“All those who believe in him shall not be confounded.”
Non enim est distinctio Judæi et Græci:
For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek.
For the same Lord is over all,
dives in omnes qui invocant illum.

Omnis enim quicumque invocaverit nomen Domini, salvus erit.
For all those who have called upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.
Quomodo ergo invocabunt, in quem non crediderunt?
Then in what way will those who have not believed in him call upon him?
aut quomodo credent ei, quem non audierunt?
Or in what way will those who have not heard of him believe in him?
And in what way will they hear of him without preaching?
And truly, in what way will they preach, unless they have been sent,
just as it has been written:
“How beautiful are the feet of those who evangelize peace,
of those who evangelize what is good!”
